question: Which of the following is a recognised subspecialty of Anaesthesiology that an Indian postgraduate may pursue after completing an MD/DA?

tipsAndFeedback.chosenFeedback: Interventional Cardiology is a subspecialty of Cardiology, not Anaesthesiology. Cardiac anaesthesia (managing patients during cardiac surgery) is the anaesthesiology subspecialty.

Correct! Paediatric Anaesthesia is a well-established subspecialty within Anaesthesiology, requiring additional training to manage the unique physiological and pharmacological challenges of neonates, infants, and children.
Neonatology is a subspecialty of Paediatrics. While anaesthesiologists care for neonates perioperatively, Neonatology itself belongs to Paediatrics, not Anaesthesiology.

Respiratory Medicine is an internal medicine subspecialty. Although anaesthesiologists manage ventilation and airways, the formal subspecialty for respiratory diseases belongs to Internal Medicine/Pulmonology.

overallFeedback.feedback: Review the career pathways section. Anaesthesiology subspecialties include Paediatric Anaesthesia, Cardiac Anaesthesia, Neuroanaesthesia, Obstetric Anaesthesia, Pain Medicine, and Critical Care — not subspecialties that belong to other parent specialties.
Excellent! Paediatric Anaesthesia is one of several Anaesthesiology subspecialties, alongside Cardiac Anaesthesia, Neuroanaesthesia, Pain Medicine, Critical Care, and Obstetric Anaesthesia.
